en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.1: One gram of Pu-238 produces just under half a Watt of decay heat.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.2: The typical plutonium RTG contains close to eight kilograms of Pu-238.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.4: A plutonium RTG was used to power the New Horizons probe that visited Pluto in 2015.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.5: Po-210 can also be used for RTGs as it generates 140 W/g of decay heat due to its 138 day half life.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.6: Pa-231 is an isotope of protactinium that easily fissions, but it isn't quite fissile.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.7: Muons generated by matter-antimatter reactions can trigger nuclear fusion reactions at room temperature.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.8: Roughly 20% of U-235 nuclei will fail to fission when hit by a neutron. They become U-236 nuclei instead.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.9: Thorium reactors are really uranium reactors that convert thorium into U-233.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.10: Natural uranium consists of 99.284% U-238, 0.711% U-235, and 0.0055% U-234.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.11: Most nuclear reactors use uranium that has been enriched to 3-5% U-235.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.12: Uranium-based nuclear weapons require uranium enriched to at least 85-90% U-235.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.13: Depleted uranium is uranium that has had most of its U-235 removed. It is effectively pure U-238.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.14: In the 1920s, uranium was considered a useless byproduct of the production of radium.
en_us.info.hbm.rtg.fact.15: The Manhattan Project referred to refined natural uranium as tuballoy, enriched uranium as oralloy, and depleted uranium as depletalloy.

zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.1: 一克钚-238产生的衰变热略低于半瓦。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.2: 典型的钚RTG含有接近八千克钚-238。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.4: 2015年探访冥王星的新视野号探测器使用钚RTG供电。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.5: 钋-210也可用于RTG：它的半衰期为138天，衰变热达到140瓦/克。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.6: 镤-231是容易发生裂变的镤同位素，但它并不属于易裂变材料。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.7: 物质与反物质反应产生的μ子可以在室温下引发核聚变反应。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.8: 约20%的铀-235原子核受到中子撞击后不会裂变，而是变成铀-236。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.9: 钍反应堆实际上是把钍转化为铀-233的铀反应堆。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.11: 大多数核反应堆使用铀-235浓度为3%至5%的浓缩铀。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.12: 铀核武器要求铀-235浓度至少达到85%至90%。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.13: 贫铀是大部分铀-235被移除后的铀，基本上是纯铀-238。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.14: 20世纪20年代，铀曾被视为生产镭时产生的无用副产品。
zh_cn.info.hbm.rtg.fact.15: 曼哈顿计划将精制天然铀称为tuballoy，浓缩铀称为oralloy，贫铀称为depletalloy。
